rules: derive canonical identity only from the schema-aware semantic projection
exclude timestamps, durations, host paths and diagnostic runtime metadata
include source, frame, represented-level, world-space geometry, authority and topology meaning
regenerate corrected Wall and evidence IDs where the legacy identity was collision-prone
mark reviews stale when governed entity or evidence identity changes
mark snapshots superseded when canonical semantic identity changes
preserve old hashes only as non-authoritative migration audit evidence
keep production consumers on the existing path until a separate migration is approved
rollback: Revert the stacked branch before activation. Never treat legacy collision-prone IDs as canonical after activation.
